businessModel: Volunteer-run; donations only; no ads or data collection
updateCadence: Usually within ~3 days of each Firefox release; no auto-updater on most platforms
summary: Firefox rapid-release fork with telemetry removed, uBlock Origin bundled, resist-fingerprinting on and Firefox AI features kept off by default. Desktop only; updates come through package managers.
bestFor: Firefox users who want privacy defaults without manual about:config work
People who want a browser with Firefox AI features off
Linux users comfortable with package managers
notFor: People who want automatic background updates on Windows/Linux
Users who need Netflix-style DRM out of the box
Android or iOS users (no mobile version)

pros.title: Hardened defaults
pros.detail: Telemetry, Pocket, sponsored content and many Mozilla connections are removed or disabled.

pros.title: uBlock Origin bundled
pros.detail: A full MV2 content blocker ships preinstalled.

pros.title: Resist Fingerprinting
pros.detail: RFP is on by default, spoofing timezone and window size.

pros.title: Firefox AI kept off
pros.detail: AI features are disabled/locked by default, aligning with its AI-free reputation.

pros.title: Fast upstream tracking
pros.detail: LibreWolf 158.0 followed Firefox 158 on the same day in Oct 2026.

cons.title: No Android/iOS
cons.detail: No mobile version; the FAQ points Android users to IronFox.

cons.title: Manual updates
cons.detail: No built-in auto-update on Windows and Linux; depends on package managers.

cons.title: Site breakage
cons.detail: RFP, disabled DRM and WebGL tweaks break some sites until adjusted.

cons.title: Volunteer project
cons.detail: Small team; longevity depends on maintainers.

faq.a: It keeps Firefox AI features disabled and locked by default, but the project does not market itself as an anti-AI browser; users can opt in.
Yes, it can be enabled and is encrypted client-side; self-hosting a sync server is possible.
DRM is disabled by default; you can enable it in settings.

timeline.event: LibreWolf forked from Waterfox/Firefox hardening configs
Firefox 148 adds AI kill switch; LibreWolf already off by default
LibreWolf 158.0 shipped same day as Firefox 158

switching.note: Imports from Firefox and other browsers; add-ons from AMO work.

startup: Slower cold start with hardened profile
tabManagement: Vertical tabs and groups from Firefox
beginnerFriendly: Needs some tweaks for some sites
